newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay reports 16.5pct rise in Apr cargo.
newsitem.headline: Cathay reports 16.5pct rise in Apr cargo.

text.p: Cathay Pacific reported a 16.5 percent rise in the amount of cargo carried during April compared to the same month last year, airline statistics show.

The increase follows a similar 16.6 percent rise in March and continues a double digit growth trend this year. But analysts say a cloud on the horizon which will have hit cargo revenue in the past month is the recent temporary grounding of Cathay's Airbus A330 fleet because of engine gearbox problems.
During April, Cathay also reported a 8.3 percent rise in cargo load factor and a 20.2 percent increase in Freight Tonne Kilometres (FTKs).
Available Tonne Kilometres (ATKs), which represents the freight and passenger capacity increased by 8.0 percent.
Passenger totals also increased by one percent to 920,337 for the month coupled with a 3.1 percent increase in flights. TRAFFIC Apr 97 Cumulative Cumulative Pct
